Ryegate Studio

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. We build long-lived systems for people who have to live with them afterwards, which is a different discipline from building something that demonstrates well once.

Our work is mostly infrastructure: schedulers, ingest pipelines, and the unglamorous machinery that decides whether a product is trustworthy at three in the morning. We have been doing it since 2011.

Practice

We take a small number of engagements each year and staff them properly. No one is assigned to four things at once, because that is how details get dropped and details are the entire job.
